_about: Starting values for the home page (spec 3.1). Proposed Nov 4 2026; Ben to confirm.

why.bar: At 85%, best value is a cheaper model than the leader in 4 of 5 jobs, so the answer shows a real trade-off. At 90% it falls back to the leader or a near-tie in most jobs; at 80% it often picks models well below the leader.
why.volume: 2,000 a month is a typical team pilot, matches the spec's example and the prototype, and makes the bill big enough to compare without being alarming.
